NOTE on p = 2 for add-71: the run above reports cover=7/8.  Lemma 3 says 2
cannot be critical at ell = 5, since full rationality of E_d[5] over Q_2 needs
zeta_5 in Q_2 and 2 is not 1 mod 5; so this had to be search depth.  Raising the
bound to M2 = 6000 gives 8/8:
   [-15, -221, -35, -185, -510, -1594, -118, 302]   cover = 8/8
